# Zazie Kanwar-Torge — Experimental Psychological Horror Film Composer | Zazie Productions

> **Experimental psychological horror film composer for independent and arthouse cinema.** Zazie Kanwar-Torge (**Zazie Productions LLC**, Asheville, North Carolina — remote worldwide) is an IMDb-credited composer working on independent features, festival shorts, and hybrid or experimental work, scored to picture rather than cut from a library. The palette is performed waterphone, bowed metal, struck & prepared strings, musique concrète field recordings, custom synthesis, and hybrid orchestration. Folk horror, body horror, dark ambient and cosmic work appear in the same catalogue but are not the studio's primary position. Published transparent starting fees begin at **$250 USD** for an individual scene, with **30 playable showreel cues**, **9 documented screen & experimental productions**, and **24 sound libraries, records, and audio tools**.

## Quick Studio Facts

- **Primary search identity:** Experimental psychological horror film composer for independent and arthouse cinema. (one sentence, stated the same way on the home page, the biography and the commission page)
- **Who it is for:** Commissions are usually independent features and shorts with a director’s point of view. Dread tends to be structural in them rather than a jump-scare device. Library-style cue requests and catalogue licences are handled through the store rather than as a commission, and every commission starts from a cut or a sequence, not a script alone.
- **Composer & Founder:** Zazie Kanwar-Torge ([IMDb nm17333332](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm17333332/))
- **Studio Legal Entity:** Zazie Productions LLC · Asheville, NC, USA (remote spotting, review, and electronic WAV delivery worldwide)
- **Direct Commission Contact:** `zaziediya@gmail.com` · `+1 (864) 430-0606` · [Request a Scoring Quote](https://horror.zazieproductions.com/contact)
- **Also in the catalogue (secondary lanes, not the position):** folk horror, body horror, supernatural dread, cosmic horror, dark ambient records, techno-thriller and dark sci-fi, plus adaptive horror game scoring
- **Signature Acoustic & Electroacoustic Palette:** Bowed metal, performed waterphone, struck & prepared strings, field & impulse recordings, granular processing, modular/custom synthesis, and hybrid orchestration
- **International Festival & Institutional Recognition:** Featured at **Ars Electronica 2026** (20.4-channel spatial audio work), **EXiS Seoul** (2025), **MUSLAB / Cero Records** (2025), **Visual Container Winter 2024 Award**, and commissioned by the **Black Mountain College Museum + Arts Center**
- **Published Commission Packages (USD, priced by scored music minutes — starting fees, reviewed 2026-10-17):**
  - **Individual Scene Scoring** — **From $250** (USD) · Approximately 1–2 minutes of original music · Includes 1 consolidated revision round. Festival scenes, pitch sequences and a single pivotal moment in a longer edit, including features.
  - **Focused Short-Film Score** — **From $650** (USD) · Approximately 3–5 minutes of original music · Includes 1 consolidated revision round. Narrative and experimental shorts where the score carries the story from the first frame.
  - **Extended Short-Film Score** — **From $1,500** (USD) · Approximately 6–12 minutes of original music · Includes 2 consolidated revision rounds. Longer shorts, series pilots and projects that need a developed thematic score.
  - **Feature Film & Experimental Cinema** — **Custom quotation** (USD) · More than 12 scored minutes, multi-part or expanded scope · Includes 2 consolidated revision rounds. Features and longer experimental films. Single-scene needs use Individual Scene Scoring; substantial scores are quoted after the studio has reviewed the cut and agreed the schedule.
- **Substantial Full-Project Feature Note:** Substantial full-length feature or experimental cinema scores carry an indicative minimum engagement of **$2,500 USD** (custom quoted after picture/script review; single-scene feature commissions remain eligible for Individual Scene Scoring from **$250 USD**).

## Selected Screen & Experimental Productions (9 Verified Records)

- [EXPIRE (2025)](https://horror.zazieproductions.com/work/expire): Short film — Zazie Kanwar-Torge credit: Sound design. EXPIRE is a 2025 science-fiction short about AI toys returning to life in a ruined world. IMDb credits Zazie Kanwar-Torge for sound design, not composition.
- [UNSEEN (2026)](https://horror.zazieproductions.com/work/unseen): Feature film — archival project record (see verified credits on page). UNSEEN is a 2026 horror-thriller feature about an unknown disaster and an abusive past. IMDb identifies Steve Merlo as composer; this archive does not assign a Zazie score credit.
- [PEREGRINUS (2026)](https://horror.zazieproductions.com/work/peregrinus): TV series — Zazie Kanwar-Torge credit: Co-composer. PEREGRINUS is a five-episode 2026 TV series about an escaped asset with psychic abilities. IMDb lists a December 31, 2026 premiere and credits Zazie Kanwar-Torge as a co-composer.
- [Phantom Requiem (2024)](https://horror.zazieproductions.com/work/phantom-requiem): Experimental short film — archival project record (see verified credits on page). Phantom Requiem is a 4:53 experimental short published by Zazie Productions on June 20, 2024. The studio describes its visuals, sound, and music as studio intellectual property.
- [ECLIPSED (2025)](https://horror.zazieproductions.com/work/eclipsed): Short film — Zazie Kanwar-Torge credit: Composer. ECLIPSED is a 2025 surreal horror short about a woman whose attempt to destroy her darker self leads to transformation. IMDb credits Zazie Kanwar-Torge and Noah C. Castro as composers.
- [THE HAUNTED](https://horror.zazieproductions.com/work/the-haunted): Short film — Zazie Kanwar-Torge credit: Co-composer. THE HAUNTED is a completed 46-minute short about a virtual-reality therapy session that turns into a waking nightmare. IMDb credits Zazie Kanwar-Torge and Robert Mason Sandifer as co-composers.
- [CHOLERIC](https://horror.zazieproductions.com/work/choleric): Short film — Zazie Kanwar-Torge credit: Co-producer. CHOLERIC is a short in post-production about a former child star whose manufactured fame begins to unravel. IMDb credits Zazie Kanwar-Torge as co-producer, not composer.
- [MIKE HAS A VISITOR](https://horror.zazieproductions.com/work/mike-has-a-visitor): Short film — Zazie Kanwar-Torge credit: Composer. MIKE HAS A VISITOR is a horror short about a man whose sleep-paralysis nightmares begin to enter his waking life. IMDb credits Zazie Kanwar-Torge as composer.
- [THE DARK AWAITS](https://horror.zazieproductions.com/work/the-dark-awaits): Reality-TV series — Zazie Kanwar-Torge credit: Composer. THE DARK AWAITS is a reality-TV series in which an ordinary family investigates haunted locations through the night. IMDb lists a 45-minute runtime and credits Zazie Kanwar-Torge as composer.
